name: Miami-Dade County, FL
findings: Miami-Dade County has 8,763 nonprofit organizations. 2,404 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,855 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Miami-Dade County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 12 professional organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 38 would.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Miami-Dade County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 140 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 639 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
